newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Woodside to acquire oil permit stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Woodside to acquire oil permit stake.

text.p: Woodside Petroleum Ltd said on Thursday it has taken a 22.5 percent stake in the WA-263-P oil and gas exploration permit in the Dampier sub-basin offshore Western Australia by contributing to a future exploration programme.
Woodside said it would acquire the stake from WMC Ltd unit WMC Petroleum Australasia and Idemitsu Oil & Gas Co Ltd, a unit of Japanese refiner Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd.
Cronin declined to forecast the total cost of the exploration work but said a well would usually cost between A$10 million and A$12 million.
Located in the Dampier sub-basin, WA-263-P is north of the producing Goodwyn platform which is operated by Woodside.
WMC and Idemitsu held equal shares in the remaining 77.5 percent of WA-263-P, Cronin said. At 0547 GMT (3.47 p.m.) Woodside shares were up 19 cents to A$8.34.
